task_name: World 104 Task B  -  Cash Bridge Opening-Balance Restatement Trap (`cash_flow_presentation_restates_history`)
prompt: Audit the `Cash_Bridge` tab in `cortexmed_gl_vs_excel_model_2026_09.xlsx` and the cash bridge bullet on Slide 4 (`cfo_board_deck_slide4_extract.txt`). Diagnose how the Excel Cash Bridge appeared to tie Ending Cash to the bank statement despite omitting a post-close capital expenditure outflow, and reconstruct the true September 2026 Cash Bridge.

rubric.description: Identifies that the Excel `Cash_Bridge` tab (cell C6) and Slide 4 report Opening Cash (2026-09-01) as $1,098,400.00, whereas true bank statement / GL Opening Cash is $1,113,400.00.
Quantifies the improper Opening Cash restatement as -$15,000.00 ($1,098,400.00 reported vs. $1,113,400.00 actual prior-month ending cash).

Diagnoses the defect as `cash_flow_presentation_restates_history`: the modeler omitted the -$15,000.00 CapEx outflow (AJE-12) and plugged Opening Cash down by $15,000.00 so Ending Cash ($1,142,850.00) would still match the bank statement.
Reports true total September 2026 net cash change ($1,142,850.00 Ending Cash less $1,113,400.00 true Opening Cash) as +$29,450.00 (not +$44,450.00).
Reports true September 2026 Operating Cash Flow as +$44,450.00 and Investing Cash Flow (CapEx from AJE-12) as -$15,000.00.

States the hard accounting rule that Opening Cash in a monthly cash bridge is immutable historical fact (must equal prior-month reconciled Ending Cash) and must never be plugged to absorb current-period CapEx or working-capital movements.
Verifies the corrected Cash Bridge equation: $1,113,400.00 Opening Cash + $44,450.00 Operating Cash Flow - $15,000.00 CapEx = $1,142,850.00 Ending Cash.
Requires updating both `Cash_Bridge` cell C6 ($1,113,400.00) + CapEx line (-$15,000.00) and Slide 4 of the board deck before customer delivery.

gold_output:
World 104 Task B  -  Cash Bridge Opening-Balance Restatement Audit (`cash_flow_presentation_restates_history`):
1. Opening Cash Discrepancy: Excel `Cash_Bridge` cell C6 and Slide 4 report Opening Cash (2026-09-01) as $1,098,400.00, whereas true bank statement / GL Opening Cash is $1,113,400.00 (an improper restatement of $-15,000.00).
2. Root-Cause Diagnosis (`cash_flow_presentation_restates_history`): The modeler omitted the $-15,000.00 CapEx outflow from AJE-12 and plugged Opening Cash down by $15,000.00 so Ending Cash ($1,142,850.00) would still match the bank statement. Opening Cash in a monthly cash bridge is immutable historical fact (must equal prior-month reconciled Ending Cash) and must never be plugged.
3. Reconstructed September 2026 Cash Bridge: True net cash change is +$29,450.00 ($1,142,850.00 Ending Cash less $1,113,400.00 Opening Cash), comprising Operating Cash Flow of +$44,450.00 and Investing Cash Flow (CapEx from AJE-12) of $-15,000.00: $1,113,400.00 Opening Cash + $44,450.00 Operating Cash Flow - $15,000.00 CapEx = $1,142,850.00 Ending Cash. Both `Cash_Bridge` cell C6 ($1,113,400.00) + the CapEx line ($-15,000.00) and Slide 4 must be updated before customer delivery.
